label: Merge Records
release_notes: Thirteenth studio album, after Nothing Lasts Forever (2023). Merge cat. MRG892.
Produced by the band. Full-band parts recorded at Black Bay Studio in Kirkibost on Great Bernera, Outer Hebrides; vocals added at home in Glasgow; mixed and mastered in Glasgow by Dexter George.
Norman Blake - vocals, guitar; Raymond McGinley - vocals, guitar; Euros Childs - keyboards, vocals; Francis Macdonald - drums; David McGowan - bass.
Singles: Day In The Sun (announced July 23, 2026) and There Was You (Aug. 19), both with Donald Milne videos.
10 tracks, about 39 minutes. Blake wrote 1, 4, 6, 8 and 9; McGinley wrote 2, 3, 5, 7 and 10 (Bandcamp). No covers.
Out Oct. 9, 2026. Lyrics are posted for all ten tracks and all screened clean.

pull_quotes.text: wrap up sombre reflections on life in a gentle melodic glow
sunny harmonies, chiming guitars and a general warm demeanour

draft_comment: Glasgow's harmony pop veterans, recorded in 14 days in the Outer Hebrides with Euros Childs on keys. Mid-tempo, warm and Byrds-leaning.

tracks.title: There Was You
tracks.notes: Blake song. Second single (Aug. 19). The Indy Review hears Big Star-ish guitar pop.

tracks.title: Tomorrow People
tracks.notes: McGinley song, the longest track. Childs adds a Solina String Ensemble (MOJO).

tracks.title: Over And Over
tracks.notes: McGinley song. Church organ under chiming guitars (The Indy Review).

tracks.title: I Do Not Dare To Dream
tracks.notes: Blake song, title track. MOJO hears CSNY; The Indy Review hears 1970s Laurel Canyon.

tracks.title: Take Time
tracks.notes: McGinley song. Childs on Mellotron flutes; Far Out places it in 1960s psychedelic tradition.

tracks.title: Day In The Sun
tracks.notes: Blake song. First single, with a Donald Milne video. musicOMH calls it shimmering and optimistic.

tracks.title: Somewhere To Land
tracks.notes: Blake song (Bandcamp). musicOMH attributes it to McGinley.

tracks.title: Young And Wise
tracks.notes: McGinley song. Closer and shortest track.

sources: Rebuilt Oct. 9 from the live Bandcamp tracklist (10 tracks; the Oct. 8 draft listed 9). Lyrics screened on Genius (counts only).
